purpose: Measure incremental distributional information from original NBM station cards against identical daily market quotes
features: One original 01 UTC NBS object per event day; object LastModified no later than local-standard-time day start. Require all eight UTC three-hour TMP grid points within the source day. Also retain next 00 UTC TXN and XND as explicitly 18-hour extrema proxies.
target: Integer exchange settlement value, reconciled against original complete NWS reports available by contract settlement; training requires settlement and selected NWS issue before fit cutoff. No winning-bracket midpoint substitution.
native_proxy: TXN mean and XND standard deviation with minimum 0.5F, explicitly a Gaussian assumption on guidance for a different window, included as a diagnostic baseline
gaussian: Weighted training residual mean/sample variance, minimum sigma 0.5F; global fit weights give each calendar day total one, station fits use equal days
empirical: Station training residual distribution mixed with one Gaussian prior observation, preserving a coherent CDF across all brackets
station_fallback: Use global fit with the same feature base if fewer than 30 training days; report fallback
spread_regression: Mean = TMP grid maximum + station intercept + beta*(TXN - grid maximum). Variance = 0.25 + exp(log_c0) + exp(log_c1)*XND^2. Gaussian NLL with equal-day weights and 0.5*sum(mean_coefficients^2); log variance coefficients bounded [-9,6]. L-BFGS-B analytic gradient, maxiter1000, ftol1e-12, gtol1e-8; no hyperparameter search.
integer_probability: Integrate one common distribution over integer outcome rounding cells: inclusive between ceil(lower)-0.5 to floor(upper)+0.5, strict greater floor(strike)+0.5 upward, strict less ceil(strike)-0.5 downward
evaluation: All models on identical eligible contracts; average contracts within event, events within UTC source day; compare market midpoint and already-frozen E002 logistic calibration at leads 24/12/6/3 hours
uncertainty: Paired calendar-day score differences, circular blocks 1/7/14 days, 10000 draws, seed 20260906; gaps leave block confidence unavailable instead of compressing time. Holm adjustment over all six models and four horizons per score/block is exploratory, not the global promotion correction.
selection: Retain all six models and disclose losses; no hyperparameter optimization, no final holdout access, no promotion or historical profit claims
availability_limit: Object storage and NWS document issue times are evidence, not independently observed original public-access/receipt histories. As-retrieved contract revisions and universe survivorship remain limitations.
